### 2026-10-02 – I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transfor

**2h**

I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transforms the air into a smooth, straight-line stream. I attached a real-world example of an inlet.

**2h**

I designed the next part of the wind tunnel, which is the nozzle. The nozzle is a contoured section that is placed just before the test section, and it is used to accelerate the airflow and create a smooth stream. I attached a picture that I used as inspiration for my design of the nozzle.

### 2026-10-02 – The next part is the comb. The comb is a metal strip with a series of tiny tubes spaced close together. It is used to measure air speed and pressure at multiple points at the same time across a cross-

**3h**

The next part is the comb. The comb is a metal strip with a series of tiny tubes spaced close together. It is used to measure air speed and pressure at multiple points at the same time across a cross-section of the airflow.

![Screenshot 2026-10-02 at 13.15.44](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/519bfb1a844af91e63a7234ee89ac1d3b80fac9f4a8d47a5443ddb00f923e642.png)

### 2026-10-02 – The next part is the diffuser. The diffuser on a wind tunnel converts kinetic energy into static pressure by slowing down fast-moving air. It is placed right before the fan so that electrical energy i

**2h**

The next part is the diffuser. The diffuser on a wind tunnel converts kinetic energy into static pressure by slowing down fast-moving air. It is placed right before the fan so that electrical energy is saved as much as possible.

![images](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gKTwWBgpcbO5BUqOyUTSgj0GrR9ZXm77/8005155f6e00ae6ed72f3eef831defe57da020ec94acce8cfbbc41021f746b99.jpeg)

**2h**

The final part is the exit, which is a sub-part of the diffuser. The exit is where the fan is located. It is also used to slow down the airflow, like the diffuser. The exit has all the same functions as the diffuser.

### 2026-10-02 – The final part of my project is the final assembly. I attached all the parts in their respective places on SolidWorks to create the final piece. Using the mates features, I joined the edges of the par

**3h**

The final part of my project is the final assembly. I attached all the parts in their respective places on SolidWorks to create the final piece. Using the mates features, I joined the edges of the parts together, and made very small changes to the dimensions to make sure it all fits perfectly. I decided to go with a subsonic wind tunnel design, so I researched about that specific type of wind tunnel.
